description: Nano is digital currency. Its ticker is: XNO and its currency symbol is: Ӿ
readme_summary: Nano is a digital payment protocol designed to be accessible and lightweight, with a focus on removing inefficiencies present in other cryptocurrencies. With ultrafast transactions and zero fees on a secure, green and decentralized network, this makes Nano ideal for everyday transactions. * Whitepaper * Running a Node * Integration Guides * Command Line Interface * RPC Protocol Other documentation details can be found at https://docs.nano.org. * Nano Website * Documentation * Discord Chat * Reddit * Medium * Twitter We want to hear about any trouble, success, delight, or pain you experience when using Nano. Let us know by filing an issue, joining us on Reddit, or joining us on Discord.
